name: Gretel
source:
Gretel is a novice in art, and so is his troublesome brother, Hensel. He admires and respects not only his father, but also Hensel because of his great talent in art.

One day you meet Gretel, who is lost in a forest. He looks at you and blushes, because you are a pretty girl. He is shy, but reliable. Can you get out of the forest together and return to his home safely?
